per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be able to run on various operating systems including Linux, Windows, and Solaris.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be packaged to deploy onto various web or application servers such as Tomcat or JBoss.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be built to standard servlet specifications without exotic native dependencies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to small actions within five seconds and heavier tasks within eight seconds.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle approximately one thousand concurrent requests in the current release and double that in the next release.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall aim for 99.99% availability excluding server-level failures.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall only allow access to company employees or explicitly approved external users.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall sanitize inputs and validate everything server-side to prevent malicious input from corrupting data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'
